title: Relational databases
brief: Understand shared relational facts, questions and guarded changes through one shop purchase. Distinguish schema rules, atomicity, concurrent decisions, query work and durability, judge relational fit and choose a practical next route.
ownership_note: Introduce enough of each concern to choose a route; children own detailed design, formal analysis and working procedures.

title: Retries and uncertain commit outcomes
brief: Distinguish a known abort from a commit whose reply was lost. Reuse one logical request identity, reject conflicting payloads, and recover the recorded result rather than applying a purchase twice.

neighbouring_ownership.outboxes-jobs: Owns external delivery and worker identity.
neighbouring_ownership.application-sql: Owns error transport and connection disposal.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-transactions: Owns native retry and ambiguous-result errors.

title: Outboxes and database-backed jobs
brief: Commit a durable intention with the domain change, then deliver or claim work despite duplicate execution and worker loss. Design deduplication, leases, expiry and fencing so recovery preserves the intended external effects.

neighbouring_ownership.locks: Owns general locking; this article applies claiming mechanisms.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-logical-replication: Owns native row-change streams rather than application outbox semantics.

title: Connections, overload and capacity
brief: Distinguish connections, active work and queued requests, then budget admitted work and recovery headroom around the real limiting resource. Choose bounded overload behaviour and validate capacity under a representative workload.

neighbouring_ownership.application-sql: Owns the lifecycle of an individual connection.
neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns temporary capacity and redundancy consumed by movement.

title: Database access and least privilege
brief: Derive runtime, migration and support privileges from their tasks. Test tenant access as the actual trusted identity, distinguishing database authorisation, application identity and row-level integrity.

neighbouring_ownership.constraints: Owns tenant integrity and composite references.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-access: Owns native roles, row policies and privileged code.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns native CockroachDB secure identities and privileges.
